name: Plan and Build
description: Structured planning and implementation process. Investigates the problem space, designs a plan, implements changes, validates, and commits. Use for any substantial feature, project, or multi-step task that benefits from upfront planning before execution.
narrative: Planning-and-building goes best in a rhythm: understand the requirement and the baseline first (read the relevant skills before you touch a tool), design the approach and get it approved, then implement ONE component at a time — never the whole thing at once — verifying and committing each before the next, and reporting what remains. Small, verified steps beat a big-bang change.
